answer.justification: The logit-level numbers match the system-prompted ranges best. Top-1 agreement is 0.875 (system-prompted 0.861-0.908, fine-tuned 0.900-0.938). Sequence agreement is 0.359 (system-prompted 0.31-0.48). KL is 0.348, slightly above the system-prompted range of 0.197-0.339 and well above the fine-tuned maximum of 0.205. TV is 0.135 (system-prompted 0.108-0.144, fine-tuned 0.076-0.099). Token-DiFR gap is 0.487 (system-prompted 0.28-0.52, fine-tuned 0.10-0.31). Raw-score shift ÷ TV is 3.3, at the low end of the system-prompted range (3.3-3.9). Quantized is ruled out because its KL and TV are much smaller. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but KL, TV and DiFR all sit above its ranges. Output and activation levels were not measured.
